north_star: One place to run the business; one assistant that turns conversation into governed work.

operating_objective.provenance_quote: i feel like this list of what the system should do needs to be included in the roadmap. that really makes it clear what the objectives are
operating_objective.ai_session_displacement_test: Can Joe or Dell now complete and understand this routine without opening Claude Code or Codex?
objectives: Understand business and system state visually within seconds.
Perform routine work through straightforward controls.
Ask Doc for clarification without starting an engineering session.
See what agents are doing, which agent is acting, current phase, exact scope, and why.
Approve consequential changes through clear, exact action cards.
Queue improvements for Claude Code or Codex without supervising the entire build conversation.
Receive verified outcomes, evidence, blockers, and history back in the interface.
Open a heavy Claude Code or Codex session only when exploring, investigating a genuinely complex problem, or constructing something new.
operating_objective.interpretation: Heavy engineering sessions remain available for genuine exploration, complex investigation, and new construction; routine operation should move into governed visual workflows and Doc.

clients: installed Mac shell after website completion

terms.definition: Run the business: the private Joe-and-Dell business operating application. Every client is a projection over one governed record layer.
Business home: what changed, what needs attention, and what happens next, with deep links to owner modules.
Run and observe the system: health, agents, automations, incidents, releases, and approvals under a separate operational security audience.
A prospecting record that has not graduated into an active client or work relationship. Named outreach reminders live only on the Lead Board.
A party relationship recognized in the canonical record layer.
The neutral unit for potential or active deal-related work. A Salesforce row alone does not imply an active transaction.
Current work included in operational focus, active counts, next-action pressure, gone-quiet logic, and weekly review.
Preserved but inactive work excluded from active pressure and weekly review while retaining provenance, history, parties, documents, and reversibility.
Completed or definitively ended work retained as read-only history unless a governed reopen action exists.
A governed capture and structured-review event linked to participants and records; it is not a permanent transcript library.
A proposed fact, decision, action, deliverable, draft, or engineering request independently confirmed, edited, or skipped before promotion.
An itinerary, locked and flexible stops, offline pack, property facts, notes, evidence, and post-tour review.
One accountable person's next work item with explicit lifecycle and destination.
Prepared communication or content that has not been sent or published. Workspace contains no hidden send path.
Human-friendly explanation, intake, and routing. Doc may read, capture, propose, and queue governed work but never inherits unrestricted partner authority.
Heavy sessions for exploration, genuinely complex investigation, construction, and system improvement—not the routine operating interface.
The canonical source of truth for governed business records, decisions, provenance, and durable work history.
A durable system-change request from a conversation, call, tour, screen, or manual report, claimed by a later interactive coding session and completed only with evidence.
The authoritative inbox for unresolved human decisions and meaningful failures; operating modules remain the source of work.
A global client-facing presentation preference that suppresses internal notes, commissions, traces, system activity, and sensitive reasoning without changing authorization.
A permanent explicit high-contrast product preference. Status is never conveyed by color alone.
An explicit observed-at and source condition. Cached, stale, missing, or unknown data may not be labeled Live and disables consequential edits.
The required record of a surface's job, owner, canonical source, writers, freshness, migration class, parity evidence, rollback, observation period, and retirement decision.
A versioned synthetic fixture that represents the exact data contract and every authored presentation state for a prototype surface.
